usage: The word '衝浪' (cung1 long6) is a noun that means 'surf' or 'surfing.'
It can refer both to the sport of riding ocean waves and the waves themselves.
You can use 衝浪 to talk about going surfing, e.g., 我鍾意去衝浪 (I like to surf).
As a noun, it often appears after verbs of motion or interest, e.g., 學習衝浪 (learn to surf).
衝浪 can also be used metaphorically in casual speech but primarily means the water sport.
